Balance Sheet

Manage the timing of accounts receivable and accounts payable.

Creating and sending customer invoices.

Recording and reconciling customer payments.
Maintaining accounts-receivable aging reports.
Monitoring outstanding and past-due invoices.
Personally following up with customers on unpaid invoices.
Resolving billing discrepancies and payment issues.
Driving timely collection of accounts receivable.

Maintain vendor records.
Coordinate and schedule vendor payments.
Ensure expenses are properly categorized and recorded.

Develop management dashboards and KPIs.
Monitor revenue, expenses, gross margin, profitability, and cash flow.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Comfortable communicating directly with U.S.-based customers, vendors, accountants, and executives.
